media_player.title: Media player playback
media_player.description: Only works with Android TV entities set up via the Android TV (ADB) integration, with ADB debugging enabled on the device. If the TV is off, it is turned on; after the wake-up delay the Android TV integration is reloaded, then we wait (up to the online timeout) for the media player to actually come online, wait the settle delay, set the volume and launch the video.

data.play_power_on_entity: Entity to use for turning on the TV (e.g. a button that powers it on; optional)
data.play_wake_delay: Wake-up delay (seconds to wait after turning the TV on, before reloading Android TV)
data.play_settle_delay: Settle delay (seconds to wait after reloading Android TV, before launching)
data.play_online_timeout: Online timeout (max seconds to wait for the TV's ADB connection to come back after the reload)
data.play_reload_interval: Reload retry interval (seconds between extra Android TV reloads while waiting for ADB; 0 = don't retry)
